Comparison of the two candidates

Recommend retaining ICES North Sea 1991 as the selected candidate for further validation. The repaired implementation now converges with finite, nonnegative results and a closed PP budget in all three methods, and its declared domain covers substantially more of LME_022 than Scotland. This supersedes the provisional Scotland preference based on the faulty ICES runtime. ICES still has material sensitivity warnings, runtime closure assumptions, no exact-model catch mapping and no recovered native

The candidates were not tested under common settings. Scotland retains its historical configured results; a separate reconstruction and diet-change trial are distinguished above. ICES uses the repaired shared engine and EE floor 0.1. This report update does not change selection or register a researcher decision. Three other registered models were screened only: Scotland 1890–1895 and two Mackinson 2007 representations.  Detailed comparison evidence Scotland report

Comparison of the two candidates

Both candidates now have convergent, finite, nonnegative results in all three reviewed formulations. ICES represents more of the North Sea, while the corrected Scotland variant has fewer diagnostic warnings and a signed researcher review. Their settings and runtime assumptions differ, so the diagnostic grades alone do not establish which model is preferable. The ICES mapping below is a proposal for review; the existing selection is not a new joint choice.

AssessmentICES North Sea 1991East Coast Scotland 1991–1995Spatial and temporal fit1991; approximately 87% of LME_022 covered by the declared ICES domain. Applying it to 2019 catch transfers a 28-year-old baseline.1991–1995; approximately 37–42% of LME_022 covered. The Scottish shelf/fleet domain is narrower than the regional catch universe.Source and runtime assumptions69 ecological groups. Deposited Rpath port differs from the unavailable native Key Run. Source parameters retained; EE floor 0.1

Scotland's corrected diagnostics use the pinned historical engine with the EE floor OFF and retain every group; they precede the signed exclusions. ICES uses the repaired engine with the EE floor ON at 0.1. The Scotland signature does not show that those groups were deleted from the trophic network or that saved coefficients changed. Broader geography, source fidelity, sensitivity and mapping confidence should be weighed together after this ICES review. Detailed comparison evidence Scotland repo
